Container.Name: rreading-glasses
Container.Overview:
rreading-glasses is a drop-in replacement for the retired Readarr metadata service. It gives Readarr forks (Bookshelf, Faustvii/Readarr) fast, complete book and author metadata, including large authors and new releases, with a Postgres cache.
**Pick a metadata source with the Repository tag**
- `blampe/rreading-glasses:latest` uses Goodreads. Backward-compatible with existing Readarr libraries. Keep Upstream set to `www.goodreads.com`. - `blampe/rreading-glasses:hardcover` uses Hardcover. Better curated, but needs a fresh Readarr/Bookshelf install. Set Upstream to `api.hardcover.app` and fill in the Hardcover Auth token.
**Before you install**
Create a Postgres database (any version, e.g. the official postgres:17 container) with a user and an empty database called `rreading-glasses`. Use a password without special characters.
**Connect your library app**
1. In Readarr or Bookshelf, open `http://YOUR-ARR:8787/settings/development` (the page is hidden, type the URL by hand). 2. Set **Metadata Provider Source** to `http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:8788` (this container) and click Save. 3. Search and add authors as usual. If files become unmapped after a metadata refresh, fix them under Library > Unmapped Files.
Do not want to self-host? The public instances are `https://api.bookinfo.pro` (Goodreads) and `https://hardcover.bookinfo.pro`.
**Notes**
- The app uses all the memory it can get for caching, so this template limits it with `--memory=256m` (upstream's compose uses 128m). Adjust in Extra Parameters. - The Goodreads cookie and requests-per-minute settings are no longer needed and have been removed. - Hardcover tokens expire every year on January 1. Generate a new one at hardcover.app > Settings > Hardcover API.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: readarr bookshelf goodreads books metadata arr hardcover bookinfo
Container.Requires: A Postgres database (any version) For the hardcover tag: a Hardcover API token (Bearer ...)

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Metadata API port. Point Readarr/Bookshelf's Metadata Provider Source at http://[IP]:8788

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP of your Postgres server, e.g. 192.168.1.10

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: Password for the Postgres user. Avoid special characters.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: Database name. It must already exist.

Config.Name: Upstream
Config.Description: Metadata upstream host. www.goodreads.com for the latest tag; api.hardcover.app for the hardcover tag.

Config.Name: Hardcover Auth
Config.Description: Only for the hardcover tag (required there). The full header value including the word Bearer, e.g. Bearer eyJ... Get it from hardcover.app > Settings > Hardcover API.

Config.Name: Proxy
Config.Description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for upstream requests.
